【原视频简介】
Big Cat's summer of burgers is complete!! Tune in to see Burgers 94 & 95 from last Friday, as Big Cat was on the home stretch of his summer of Burgers. Eating 100 burgers in one summer was no easy feat, and he joined me to discuss the journey. 

In this video I share tips and tricks for making the perfect burger at home, differences between grilling & pan searing, and more!! Check it out to learn how to make the perfect burger. 

Look for Heinz Verified as the sign of a great restaurant, learn more at: https://www.heinz.com/heinzverified 

New episodes every week — hit subscribe to stay hungry.
